latest_release.name: v1.11.2
latest_release.body:
## English

### Features
- **Custom Toolbar Icons**: Customize tool button icons using text, emojis, built-in icons, or gallery images with optional monochrome theme tinting
- **Collab Room Save Permissions & Live Settings**: Lock rooms to allow saving only each participant's own, shared, and background layers upon exit while blocking in-room full-canvas saves and exports (including for the host), and let hosts update visibility, title, password, approval, and capacity in real time
- **Host Collab from Existing Canvas**: Start a collaborative room directly from any saved gallery artwork via the room creation dialog or artwork menu
- **Collab Quick Interactions & Navigation**: Added quick chat phrases, canvas pin markers, one-tap jump to member cursors, and confirmation prompts before destructive room actions
- **Transform Nudge Acceleration & Snapping**: Hold directional nudge keys for smooth acceleration, and toggle magnetic, grid, or constrained angle snapping during transforms
- **Dynamic Color & Bilingual Changelog**: Enabled Material You dynamic color theming by default on Android 12+, added an in-app changelog viewer following your current language, and unified English fallback localization

### Bug Fixes
- **Collab Relay Auto-Fallback & Reconnect Recovery**: Automatically switches to relay mode when direct connections stall, adds a manual relay switch and non-blocking canvas sync banner, and preserves participant identity after drops or background switches for one-tap reconnection
- **Drawing Guides Corner Fix & Grid Transform**: Fixed accidental corner kinks when starting strokes near drawing guides, and added position and angle adjustments for 2D and isometric grids
- **Safe Gallery Rename & Small-Canvas Recording**: Prevented gallery renames from silently overwriting existing artworks with the same name, and eliminated brief recording hitches when drawing on small canvases

### Improvements
- **Collab Dialogs & Brush Panel Polish**: Unified collaborative painting dialog layouts, added the "Own Layers Only" scope indicator, and refined the Brush Panel header buttons and list layout
- **Extended Localization Completion**: Completed Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Cat language translations for custom toolbar icons, changelog, transform snapping, drawing guides, and collaborative painting updates

---

## 简体中文

### 新增特性 (Features)
- **自定义工具栏图标**: 支持使用文字、表情、内置图标或相册图片自定义工具图标，并支持透明单色图片随主题染色
- **茶绘保存权限与实时改房配置**: 支持建房时锁定「仅本人画作」保存权限（房主同受限，房内禁用保存与导出，退房保留本人、公共与背景图层），并支持房主在线调整房间公开状态、名称、密码、审批及人数上限
- **从现有画布创建茶绘房间**: 支持在建房页面或画廊作品菜单中直接选择本地已有画布作品创建茶绘房间
- **茶绘快捷互动与安全提示**: 新增画布快捷聊天、坐标标记、一键定位成员光标，以及踢人、转交房主、解散房间与不保存退出的二次确认
- **变换微调加速与吸附开关**: 支持长按方向微调键连续加速，并新增磁力吸附、网格吸附与角度约束吸附开关
- **莫奈动态取色与双语更新日志**: Android 12 及以上设备默认启用动态取色，并在设置内新增按当前语言自动适配、支持离线查看的更新日志弹窗

### 缺陷修复 (Bug Fixes)
- **茶绘自动中继降级与断线恢复**: 直连打洞卡顿时自动切换至稳定中继线路，新增手动强制中继开关与同步进度浮条，并在网络波动或切后台重连后保留原成员身份实现一键恢复
- **绘图辅助起笔折角与网格调节**: 修复贴近辅助线起笔时的折角偏差，并支持调节 2D 网格与等轴测网格的位置和角度
- **画廊防覆盖重命名与小画布录制流畅度**: 修复画廊重命名同名作品时静默覆盖旧文件的问题，并消除小画布绘制过程录制抓帧带来的轻微卡顿

### 体验优化与调整
- **茶绘弹窗与笔刷面板视觉优化**: 统一茶绘大厅、房间管理与结束保存弹窗的卡片排版与权限提示，并优化笔刷面板顶栏切换按钮排布与列表样式
- **补全多语言本地化**: 补全自定义图标、更新日志、变换吸附、绘图辅助与新版茶绘全部文案的繁体中文、日语及猫猫语翻译

# ReveriePaint [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README_ZH.md)

A native Android digital painting app powered by the Krita image engine and Jetpack Compose
--- ## Official Navigation - **Official Website**: [reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top](https://reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top) - **Documentation**: [reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top/docs/](https://reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top/docs/) --- ## Architecture ReveriePaint utilizes a hybrid architecture: ``` Kotlin / Jetpack Compose UI (Touch interactions and modern UI) │ JNI C++ ReverieCore (Document management and rendering pipeline) │ C++ Krita Core Engine (KisImage / KisPainter / KisPaintOp) ``` - **UI Layer**: Jetpack Compose optimized for tablet touch gestures, supporting Material You dynamic colors and custom workspace themes - **Core Layer**: C++ native engine wrapping Krita brush engines and compositing pipeline, executing rendering asynchronously off the main thread --- ## Key Capabilities - **Krita Native Brush Pipeline**: Integrated Krita paintop engine with 240+ presets, custom brush studio, and pressure dynamic curves - **Layer & Blending System**: Layer groups, filter layers, clipping masks, alpha lock, and 25 blend modes - **Stylus & Touch Gestures**: Low-latency pressure adaptation, hover cursor preview, two-finger pan/zoom/rotate, and two-finger tap undo - **Event-Stream Recording & Auto-Save**: Lightweight binary stroke recording with variable-speed time-lapse playback and background auto-save For detailed technical guidelines, refer to the [User Guide](https://reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top/docs/), [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) --- ## Installation & Requirements ### System Requirements - Operating System: Android 7.0 and above (API 23+) - Architecture: 64-bit ARM only (`arm64-v8a`) - Recommended: Android tablets with active pressure-sensitive stylus support ### Download Channels - **Official Releases**: Download the latest APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/LanRhyme/ReveriePaint/releases) - **Mirror Source**: Fast download via [MirrorChyan](https://mirrorchyan.com/zh/projects?rid=ReveriePaint&os=android) ### Crash Reporting & Privacy Official builds enable automatic crash reporting by default to help diagnose crashes, uploading only the crash stack trace, device model, OS version, and current page/tool tag **No artwork content, filenames, account credentials, ad IDs, or location data are ever collected**, and you can disable it anytime under Settings -> Privacy & Diagnostics (which also clears the local installation ID) For the complete field list and retention policy, see [docs/PRIVACY.md](docs/PRIVACY.md), and for self-hosted builds you can pass `-Ptelemetry=false` (or omit `TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT`) for a completely offline build --- ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who contributed to ReveriePaint: Check out [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to learn how to get involved --- ## Sponsorship ReveriePaint is maintained by independent creators and community contributors, if you enjoy using ReveriePaint, consider supporting development via Afdian: - **Afdian**: [afdian.com/a/LanRhyme](https://afdian.com/a/LanRhyme) --- ## License & Credits - **Application Source**: [GPL-3.0 License](LICENSE) - **Image Engine**: [Krita](https://invent.kde.org/graphics/krita) (GPL-3.0) - **Icon Assets**: [Tabler Icons](https://tabler.io/icons) (MIT) --- ## Community & Support - **Official Website**: [reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top](https://reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top) - **Documentation**: [reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top/docs/](https://reveriepaint.lanrhyme.top/docs/) - **Discord**: [discord.gg/yUVVJSpMW](https://discord.gg/yUVVJSpMW) - **QQ Group**: 729283213 - **Issues & Suggestions**: Submit feedback on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/LanRhyme/ReveriePaint/issues)
